review_notes: The file has a single theorem, so any repetition would have to be with proofs elsewhere. I read the whole file and compared it with Tangent/Lie/Adjoint/Fixed.lean and the other uses of `cotangentDualLieEquiv`. The only overlap is moving "Lie-central" between the dual Lie algebra and the tangent Lie algebra along `cotangentDualLieEquiv`. Fixed.lean does this in a two-line `simpa` and Lie.lean does it in a short injectivity argument. That is a short calculation, not substantial repeated reasoning, and a shared lemma would be a thin wrapper. The other uses of the equivalence are about different statements (Killing form, solvability, quotients). I found no justified finding. I am only moderately sure about the uses outside the grep hits I looked at.
